name: shadcn-svelte
summary: Community Svelte port of shadcn/ui: copy-paste components built with Bits UI and Tailwind CSS.
description: An unofficial community-led Svelte port of shadcn/ui: accessible, customizable components you copy into your app, built with TypeScript, Tailwind CSS and Bits UI primitives. The docs cover installation for SvelteKit, Vite and Astro, theming, dark mode, forms and a per-component catalog; a CLI adds components and a registry publishes and distributes them.
contains: copy-paste Svelte components built with Bits UI and Tailwind CSS
form and input components: button, checkbox, combobox, date picker, field, input, input OTP, select
first components: accordion, alert, alert dialog, attachment, avatar, badge, breadcrumb, calendar, card
CLI to add components and a registry to publish and distribute code
installation guides for SvelteKit, Vite and Astro
